# SD13-E4-F7 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 1 spontaneous spell-burden baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer level 1 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat)
# and stays a single-class, level-1-only spell-bearing baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every spell-support surface: no spell slots, no spells known, no
# spell DCs, no bonus spells, no prepared posture, no general spell totals, and no
# bloodline-power resolution. It adds only the minimum choice data needed to make the
# Sorcerer class identity, the bloodline burden, and the spontaneous known-spell / slot
# posture burden legible; those burdens are intentionally left for the runtime and matrix
# to name as still blocking.
